findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_batch, lockfile_pin_delta, deep_audit, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search · Private data: extract_batch, lockfile_pin_delta, scan, schemaforge, enrich, wallet_enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search, agent_surface_budget_audit, settlement_proof, transaction_receipt, solana_transaction_receipt, wallet_policy_conformance, stateful_wallet_policy_conformance · Public sink: schemaforge, enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search, settlement_proof, transaction_receipt, solana_transaction_receipt · Destructive: extract, deep_audit, wallet_policy_conformance, stateful_wallet_policy_conformance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_batch, lockfile_pin_delta, deep_audit, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search · Private data: extract_batch, lockfile_pin_delta, scan, schemaforge, enrich, wallet_enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search, agent_surface_budget_audit, settlement_proof, transaction_receipt, solana_transaction_receipt, wallet_policy_conformance, stateful_wallet_policy_conformance · Public sink: schemaforge, enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, seller_integrity_audit, contract_qualified_search, settlement_proof, transaction_receipt, solana_transaction_receipt · Destructive: extract, deep_audit, wallet_policy_conformance, stateful_wallet_policy_conformance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
